name: Těchlovice (Hradec Králové District, Czechia)
description: Green field with a vertical stripe of yellow, white and yellow in the centre and a white five-petalled flower with yellow centre in each green part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 April 2010 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
